data.title: 中野五月 · 遮阳伞下的红颊冰淇淋
data.description: 碧海蓝天下的金黄沙滩上，五月优雅地坐在红白相间的遮阳伞阴凉下。她身穿一袭端庄的深红色荷叶边裙摆连体泳装，小口品尝着插着小彩伞的草莓双球圣代。海风撩起她赤红的长卷发，面对迎面走来的同伴，她有些难为情地微红了耳根。
data.action: sitting under parasol, eating ice cream parfait, blushing ears, modest posture
data.lighting: soft canopy shade against dazzling ocean sun
data.promptProse: Sitting demurely under a striped beach parasol overlooking the bright blue sea, Nakano Itsuki wears an elegant ruffled crimson one-piece swimsuit. She blushes cutely while spooning a bite of strawberry ice cream, her long reddish locks blowing softly in the sea breeze.
data.animaCaption: Itsuki enjoying strawberry ice cream under a beach umbrella in a red swimsuit.
